kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستنسر (form X)
# نَسْتَنْسِرُ (nastansiru) /nas.tan.si.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْسَرَ (istansara)
# نَسْتَنْسِرَ (nastansira) /nas.tan.si.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْسَرَ (istansara)
# نَسْتَنْسِرْ (nastansir) /nas.tan.sir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْسَرَ (istansara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
